name: Path of Defense
summary: At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek teaches young Horde warriors to defend those who cannot defend themselves. He sends them to Thunder Ridge to test their endurance against its electric beasts.

sections.title: The Shield of the Horde
sections.body: At the Far Watch Post, Uzzek teaches young warriors that the Horde has a duty to defend. The post lies on the border between the Barrens and Durotar. He says a warrior’s highest calling is to stand between danger and those unable to defend themselves. They take the blows so the Horde can endure.

sections.title: Trial of Thunder
sections.body: Uzzek sends the novices to Thunder Ridge, north across the Southfury River in Durotar, to test their stamina and resolve. Thunder lizards and lightning hides roam the canyon. The initiates must endure the beasts’ jolts and gather their singed scales. That trial shows they have the fortitude to hold the front line.

faq.q: Who gives the Path of Defense quest?
faq.answer: Veteran Uzzek gives the trial at the Far Watch Post, on the border between Durotar and the eastern Barrens.
Thunder Ridge lies in western Durotar, north of the main road and across the bridge over the Southfury River. Aggressive thunder lizards and lightning hides roam its ravine.

faq.q: Why does Uzzek demand singed scales specifically?
faq.answer: Uzzek asks for singed scales from the shock-wielding beasts of Thunder Ridge. Enduring their electrical attacks proves a warrior has the toughness and resilience to learn advanced defensive techniques.

faq.q: What is the philosophical lesson behind this trial?
faq.answer: Uzzek teaches that a warrior’s duty is not merely to slay, but to shield others. Surviving the beasts’ fury helps initiates learn to protect weaker allies.

faq.q: What comes next after completing Path of Defense?
faq.answer: After you prove your defensive mettle to Uzzek, he directs you to continue your martial training with Thun'grim Firegaze.
No. This rite is for warriors. It tests and teaches recruits the basics of guard duty and defensive combat.

angles.text: As a warrior, you begin learning defensive discipline. True martial strength lies in shielding your allies from devastation.
At the Far Watch Post, Horde guards protect the road into the Barrens. Their resilience matters to Horde security.
